dedupe_keys.name: application variability adaptaer ava module 1 new devices finder ndf module 2 edaf edge deployment alternatives finder and energy consumption and latency minimizer eclam module 4

description: This Zenodo software package describes four Python modules for configuring and placing applications on edge-computing infrastructure. AVA adapts an application to available nodes, NDF identifies a minimum device set for functions, EDAF enumerates feasible deployment alternatives, and ECLAM searches energy or latency objectives. The provider lists a real university-campus proof of concept and synthetic benchmarks with configurable node, service and task counts. Device CPU, RAM and workload and task connection or timing constraints are represented, with Z3 named as a dependency. The modules can support capacity or placement experiments for digital infrastructure. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the four-module suite. The package is one public ZIP under CC BY 4.0. Its description contains a naming inconsistency for the third scenario, which calls ECLAM while introducing EDAF; the draft follows the module list and does not assert a tested interface. Benchmark characteristics are randomly generated, not measured campus loads. Neither code nor solver was downloaded or executed.
